BiblicalUsage: Hadar is an Edomite. In Genesis 36:39, the text says "and Hadar reigned in his stead." The life behind the name is told on the Hadar People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hadar matters because God knows His people by name, and Hadar is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
